chapter: Follow-up questions, Bird and the Ellington sidemen
title: The White Rose bar and the occupational hazard
summary: Intermissions at the White Rose with Ben Webster, Don Byas, Billie Holiday and Sarah Vaughan.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Yeah. That's the only thing I knew, you know? So in those days with Charlie Parker, we used to discuss quite a bit, you know? In the same bar where Ben Webster used to go and get a drink and Don Weiss (PHONETIC) Byas would wait for him to get drunk.
It's the White Rose, you know? There's a chain of those bars in New York where we'd always go at the

intermission. It was just right around the corner, you know. And we would all go there. And there's Billie Holiday and Sarah Vaughan, singers, you know, and musicians, we'd party. This is a funny industry. We have a -- what do they call it -- something where -- oh, gee whiz. I can't think of the word. But it's a hazard, industrial hazard, you know?
